verdict.rationale: Retell documents and hosts an official MCP server (mcp.retellai.com) that lets MCP-capable clients like Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Claude Code build and manage Retell voice agents via the Retell API, exposing meta-tools for listing/invoking endpoints. A runtime probe confirms the server completes a full keyless JSON-RPC initialize handshake and exposes its tool set, corroborating the vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent/community usage reports of the MCP server in practice beyond vendor docs and the probe.
